findings.source_quote: ἐξώτεροι δὲ ἐτέθησαν, ὅτι ὑγιέστεροι εὑρέθησαν.
findings.english_quote: They were placed outside because they were found to be sounder.
findings.issue: “Outside” presents these accepted stones as outside the building, whereas the source places them in its outer portion. This obscures the distinction between stones incorporated into the tower's outer structure and stones rejected from the building. The same defect recurs in paragraphs 5 and 7.
findings.suggested_revision: Proposed for fresh review: “They were placed in the outer part of the building because they were found to be sounder.” Review corresponding outer-placement wording in paragraphs 5 and 7.

findings.source_quote: καὶ ἦραν αὐτοὺς αἱ παρθένοι καὶ ἔθηκαν εἰς τὴν οἰκοδομὴν τοῦ πύργου μέσους.
findings.english_quote: The virgins lifted them and placed them inside the tower’s building.
findings.issue: “Inside” does not explicitly preserve μέσους, the placement in the middle. The distinction matters because the passage contrasts middle stones with stronger outer stones. Comparable middle-placement wording is also reduced to “inside” in paragraphs 4 and 6, and paragraph 5 calls the supported middle stones merely those “placed inside.”
findings.suggested_revision: Proposed for fresh review: “The virgins lifted them and placed them in the middle of the tower’s structure.” Preserve the explicit middle location in paragraphs 4–6 as well.

findings.source_quote: ἐξώτεροι δὲ ἐτέθησαν, ὅτι ὑγιέστεροι εὑρέθησαν.
findings.english_quote: They were put outside because they were sounder.
findings.issue: The source describes placement in the outer portion of the building, not exclusion outside it. “Outside” therefore blurs incorporation into the tower with rejection from it. The same defect occurs in paragraphs 5 and 7.
findings.suggested_revision: Proposed for fresh review: “They were put in the outer part of the building because they were sounder.” Review the corresponding wording in paragraphs 5 and 7 independently.

findings.source_quote: καὶ ἦραν αὐτοὺς αἱ παρθένοι καὶ ἔθηκαν εἰς τὴν οἰκοδομὴν τοῦ πύργου μέσους.
findings.english_quote: They placed them inside the tower’s building.
findings.issue: The translation omits the narrated lifting and reduces the explicit middle placement to generic placement inside. Paragraphs 4 and 6 likewise lose the middle location, and paragraph 5 reduces the supported middle stones to “those inside.”
findings.suggested_revision: Proposed for fresh review: “The virgins lifted them and placed them in the middle of the tower’s structure.” Preserve the middle location in paragraphs 4–6.

findings.source_quote: καὶ λαβὼν ἐλατόμησε πολλοὺς ἐξ αὐτῶν
findings.issue: The simplified edition omits λαβών, the shepherd's taking the stones before cutting them. This action is preserved in the standard edition and is separately present in the source.
findings.suggested_revision: Proposed for fresh review: “He took many of them and cut them.”

findings.source_quote: ὅτι ὑγιεῖς εὑρέθησαν, ὥστε δύνασθαι αὐτοὺς κρατεῖν τοὺς εἰς τὸ μέσον τεθέντας
findings.english_quote: They were sound, so they were placed outside to support those inside.
findings.issue: Beyond the placement defects identified separately, “to support” converts the source's expressed capability or result—being able to support the middle stones—into a purpose for placement. The simplified text no longer explicitly states that capability.
findings.suggested_revision: Proposed for fresh review: “They were placed in the outer part because they were sound and could support the stones placed in the middle.”

findings.source_quote: Καὶ ἀρξάμενοι πρῶτον τοὺς μέλανας κατενοοῦμεν λίθους.
findings.english_quote: Retain all seven stone conditions, the three strikes, the two-day interval, inside/outside placement, setting aside versus rejection and no-joint selection; preserve all substantive alternative notes.
findings.issue: This unit-specific simplification metadata claims retention of three strikes, a two-day interval, and a no-joint selection, none of which occurs in the selected source or this English unit. The supplied report locates the strikes and no-joint selections in other units. The metadata therefore misstates this edition's coverage.
findings.suggested_revision: Remove the unrelated coverage claims or explicitly label them as cross-unit project decisions with their actual unit references. Describe this unit's middle-versus-outer placement accurately.

summary: Both editions require revision, principally to preserve the distinction between middle and outer portions of the tower rather than merely inside and outside. The simplified edition also omits actions, changes explicit capability into purpose, and contains inaccurate unit-specific metadata. The bracketed supplements and unresolved white-stone crux are disclosed; the declared working readings should not be replaced merely because alternatives exist. This review evaluates the supplied source and attributed reports, without authenticating unseen manuscripts or certifying an exhaustive collation. All proposed wording requires fresh review.
